name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Ellis' grade is immediately next to the Biology class.
Ellis' grade is lower than both the French class and the member of the Yearbook club.
Boyd's grade is higher than both the History class and the member of the Yearbook club.
The member of the Choir club has a higher grade than the Biology class.
